title: You can fool people…
paragraphs:
You can fool people…
…but you cannot fool God.

You can lift your hands in worship—
and still be hiding something you refuse to surrender.

And that tension right there?
That quiet, uncomfortable weight in your chest?
That’s God knocking on the door you’ve been pretending doesn’t exist.
Because here’s the truth most people won’t say out loud:

You can build a whole “Christian life”
around avoiding one honest moment with God.

You can serve.
Lead.
Post Bible verses.
Say “God is good” with a steady voice—
while secretly negotiating with sin in the dark.
“If God really sees this… will He still want me?”
A quiet guilt that doesn’t leave.
“Don’t let them see the real you.”
📖 “Woe to you… you clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.” (Matthew 23:25)
God is not impressed by your outside.
He sees the inside you’re trying to manage.
And some scholars interpret this passage as Jesus rebuking religious leaders specifically—
but the principle reaches all of us:
Because if all you hear is exposure… you’ll run.
But if you hear the Gospel… you’ll come home.
You don’t have a sin problem that better behavior can fix.
You have a heart problem that only Jesus can redeem.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)
The one reading this right now.
Sin isn’t just what you do.
It’s who you are without Christ.
And no amount of performance can erase it.
But this is where grace explodes into the story.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)
Not when you cleaned yourself up.
Not when you fixed your image.
Jesus didn’t die for your mask.
He died for your real, unfiltered, exposed self.
He absorbed the judgment you were trying to avoid.
📖 “He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree…” (1 Peter 2:24)
So you don’t have to carry them anymore.
But here’s the part many skip.
📖 “If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just and will forgive us… and purify us from all unrighteousness.” (1 John 1:9)
But to come clean before a holy God who already sees everything—
and still chose the cross for you.
The God who knows your worst—
You don’t have to keep carrying this.
You don’t have to keep splitting your life into “public faith” and “private compromise.”
You don’t have to live exhausted from maintaining an illusion.
You can take off the mask.
“Lord, this is who I really am.”
📖 “There is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 8:1)
That’s not permission to keep hiding.
That’s freedom to finally be honest.
Bring the secret into the light.
Stop negotiating with the sin that Jesus already died to break.
And let Him do what performance never could—
If this hit something deep in you…
Type “OPEN MY HEART” if you’re ready to stop performing and start surrendering.
